'''Foj Nomag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Foj Nomag was a criminal who manufactured bombs and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] 73 individuals. He was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] along with 49 other of the most dangerous criminals on [[M'Bardi]] and would be shipped to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While being guarded by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the cruiser was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The cruiser's main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] was damaged, causing the prison cells to open. While the Jedi were trying to keep the prisoners contained and under controll, the crew tried to repair the reactor until they ultimately failed. Knowing that the ship was going to be destroyed very soon, Nomag was among the prisoners to cooperate with the Jedi and helped repair the ship, allowing it to move safely through Republic space. Skywalker thanked the prisoners for helping and guaranteed their aid will affect their parole.
